limitations: Run position was not randomized; task composition and response selection can differ across runs.
The estimand concerns observed valid responses, not every offered decision; sub-05/run-01 retains 21/86 trials (65 absent-code rows).
Small cohort of 16 participants; percentile bootstrap describes participant-level uncertainty without a hypothesis test.
No RT-band sensitivity variant was requested or run.
Source declares BIDS 1.0.0rc4; no current BIDS validation was attempted.
Fresh retrieval, environment rebuild from the Pixi lock, other platforms, and independent reproduction were not attempted.
Replay uses a fresh local venv and workspace but shares the installed Python binary and host OS.
No external publication; generated-code licensing and long-term retrieval remain unresolved.
Outer duct capture and native capture were supplied by the runner; their records were not inspected or independently verified. No separate duct record is claimed for each computation.
No DataLad transformation record was created; executable command and hash manifests record this local analysis.
Paper T.4 includes versions while checklist/principles retain T.5; newer paper S.2, M.3, D.3 licensing requirements are not silently mapped into older checklist items.
This is an unreviewed agent assessment, not independent validation or an official STAMPED compliance score.
